ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 70% high-intensity (white) central surface area bounded by 30% low-intensity (black) peripheral margins and interior mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the central regions of both lobes. Thick black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edges and tips. A distinct vertical black linear mark is present on the medial-left lobe, with irregular black mottling clustered near the posterior boundary of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity towards the outer lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curvature with a slight upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, circular pixel clusters concentrated along the transition zone between the white interior and black trailing edge on both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, prominent, dark curved vertical line on the left lobe, breaking the high-intensity white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear scar on the left lobe; heavy irregular scarring and pigmentation along the trailing edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Broad, continuous black 'framing' pigmentation along the trailing edge that contrasts sharply with the predominantly white fluke interior.
